commitResults.messageTitle: Add optional remark to Person model
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a Remark value class that accepts any non-null text.
Extend Person with remark access, equality, hashing, and string output.
Keep existing constructors compatible by defaulting to an empty remark.

Add tests for remark values, constructor defaults, and person identity.
Validation: complete Gradle check passed with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support remarks in add and preserve them on edit
commitResults.messageBody:
Accept an optional r/ prefix when adding a person, default to an empty
remark, and reject repeated remark prefixes. Preserve the existing
remark when editing other fields to avoid losing student notes.

Update command usage and test helpers, and add regression tests for
optional remarks, repeated prefixes, and preservation during edits.

Validation: complete Gradle check passed with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Persist remarks and display them on student cards
commitResults.messageBody:
Save and load remarks through the JSON person adapter. Default missing
or null remarks to empty text so existing data files remain usable.

Display remarks in a wrapping student card label and hide empty remarks.
Add JSON round-trip, legacy-data, and file persistence tests.

Validation: complete Gradle check passed with Java 25.

Reject remarks exceeding 4000 Unicode code points in the model,
add command, and JSON loading. Report the same validation message
through the parser and storage error paths.

Add boundary, Unicode, and persistence regression tests.
Gradle check, coverage, and shadowJar passed with 270 tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove phone and address from student records
commitResults.messageBody:
Allow students to be added with name, student ID, and email without
requiring phone or address. Remove the obsolete fields from the model,
add and edit commands, storage, UI, and sample data.

Keep existing tag behavior and remarks. Load older JSON records while
ignoring legacy phone and address properties, and omit them on saving.
Update affected tests and the invalid-record fixture.

Validation: all 252 tests and Checkstyle passed with Java 25.

Centralize remark parsing alongside the other parameter parsers.
Document parser inputs, return values, and exceptions.

Add direct tests for empty and null input, whitespace trimming,
preserved internal text, length boundaries, and Unicode code points.

Validation: complete Gradle check passed with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Validate student names and email addresses
commitResults.messageBody:
Align the shared name and email rules with the TeachAssist specification.
Support Unicode names, collapse repeated spaces, and enforce name length
and character constraints. Validate email lengths and domain labels while
preserving local-part case and normalizing the domain to lowercase.

Cover validation boundaries and normalization in model, parser, and
storage tests. Verify with the complete Java 25 Gradle check.

Report specific errors for unknown, repeated, missing, and empty add
parameters before validating field values. Reject embedded line breaks
and preserve repeatable tags and remarks containing numeric slash text.

Recognize prefixes at the start of arguments or after whitespace,
including tabs, while preserving joined text as parameter values.
Cover add parsing and shared-tokenizer regressions with tests.

Verify with the complete Java 25 Gradle check.

Display the normalized Student ID, name, optional remark, and total
student count after adding a record. Identify duplicate Student IDs
without merging existing details, and align the invalid-format message
with the supported add syntax.

Cover feedback, duplicate rejection, and usage errors with tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save student changes before updating the model
commitResults.messageBody:
Execute modifying commands against a temporary model with the current
filter. Save successfully before publishing records and filter changes
to the live model, and leave read-only commands free of data-file writes.

Write JSON to a temporary file and replace the destination atomically
to preserve existing data when saving fails. Cover failed writes,
temporary-file cleanup, and filtered-index behavior with tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Protect student data after startup loading fails
commitResults.messageBody:
Start with an empty student list when no data file exists. When loading
fails, keep the invalid file and block modifying commands until the file
is fixed and the application is restarted.

Pass the startup loading result to LogicManager and keep read-only
commands available. Cover missing and corrupt files with startup tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document the completed add student feature
commitResults.messageBody:
Describe add syntax, field constraints, parameter errors, feedback, and
duplicate handling. Update examples to omit removed phone and address
fields and include optional remarks.

Explain saving before publishing model changes, atomic replacement, and
startup loading protection in the Developer Guide. Update the add use
case and the User Guide persistence instructions.

Replace displayed-list indices with normalised Student IDs so a student
can be deleted even when hidden by a search filter. Preserve the filter
and remove the complete student record through the safe-save workflow.

Share unknown-prefix detection between add and delete parsers, validate
delete command structure, and cover parsing, filtered deletion, and
persistence failures with tests. Update the guides and sequence diagrams.

Validation: Gradle check passed with 316 tests and Checkstyle; diff check
passed. Diagram sources were checked but were not rendered.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate unreadable and invalid data file errors
commitResults.messageBody: All student data loading failures were reported the same way. Report "Unable to load student data." when the file cannot be read, and "Unable to load student data. The data file may be corrupted or invalid." when its contents are not valid student data.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep duplicate Student ID message when loading fails
commitResults.messageBody: Loading reported every invalid record as a corrupted or invalid data file, hiding the duplicate Student ID message. Signal duplicates with DuplicateStudentIdException so storage keeps their specific message.
Keep duplicate Student ID message when loading fails
The outcome of loading student data was only written to the log. Show it in the result display when the app opens: the number of students loaded, that no data file exists yet, or why loading failed.
Failing to create the data folder was reported as a general save failure. Signal it with DataStorageLocationException and show "Unable to create data storage location." instead.

Pass the loading outcome to LogicManager alongside isStudentDataAvailable, and have MainWindow read it from Logic. This keeps UiManager unchanged and lets the startup tests check the message that the UI displays.
